Row 5 EIGHT death frames: startled, knees buckle, kneel, collapse, tip sideways, fallen, still fallen, still fallen. Row 6 EIGHT special-ability frames: gather energy, windup, lunge, release, bright impact, follow-through, cape recoil, ready. Keep character identity, proportions, size, equipment and colors identical across grid; animate poses not appearance. Avoid blurry gradients, fake checkerboard, opaque backgrounds, cropped subjects, duplicated identical action rows.
